create_wrapperlinear: create a WrapperLinear module to wrap a torch.nn.Linear layer with quantization and min-max tuning enabled
build_wrapperblock: build a wrapper_block call to wrap all supported linear and conv1d layers in a model block for quantization tuning
unwrapper_block: unwrapper a model block by calling unwrapper_block with best tuning parameters to restore original quantized layers
compute_scale_shape: compute the quantization scale tensor shape for a weight tensor using get_scale_shape with a given group size
create_wrapperlayernorm: create a WrapperLayerNorm module to wrap a layer normalization layer with fake quantized weights for tuning
